en.content: The debut of Generation 4 and the Nintendo DS. Sinnoh, 107 new Pokémon and the change that redefined battles: each move is now physical or special on its own.

cards.title: Novidades desta versão
cards.content:
• 107 Pokémon novos, chegando a 493.
  • Divisão física/especial por golpe, e não mais por tipo.
  • Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection: trocas e batalhas online, e a GTS (desligadas em 2014).
  • O Pokétch, o relógio com apps, e o Subterrâneo de Sinnoh.
  • Super Concursos com Poffins, figurino e dança.
  • A tela de toque do DS nos menus e no Pokétch.

en.title: What this version introduced
en.content:
• 107 new Pokémon, bringing the total to 493.
  • The physical/special split by move instead of by type.
  • Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection: online trades and battles, and the GTS (shut down in 2014).
  • The Pokétch, the app watch, and the Sinnoh Underground.
  • Super Contests with Poffins, dress-up and dance.
  • The DS touch screen in menus and the Pokétch.

cards.title: Melhorias em relação a a Geração 3
cards.content:
• O ciclo de dia e noite volta, com transições mais suaves.
  • Duas telas e visual 3D nos cenários.
  • Pokémon da Geração 3 migram pelo Pal Park.
  • Muitos Pokémon antigos ganham evoluções novas (Magnezone, Togekiss, Rhyperior...).

en.title: Improvements over Generation 3
en.content:
• The day-night cycle returns, with smoother transitions.
  • Two screens and 3D scenery.
  • Generation 3 Pokémon migrate through Pal Park.
  • Many older Pokémon gain new evolutions (Magnezone, Togekiss, Rhyperior...).

cards.title: Novidades desta versão
cards.content:
• O Distortion World e a Forma Origem do Giratina.

  • A Battle Frontier no lugar do Battle Park.

en.title: What this version introduced
en.content:
• The Distortion World and Giratina’s Origin Forme.
  • Shaymin’s Sky Forme and Rotom’s forms.
  • The Battle Frontier in place of the Battle Park.
  • A Sinnoh Pokédex of 210 species.
  • The Wi-Fi Plaza, Vs. Recorder and Spin Trade.
  • An IV judge and a Hidden Power reader, and three new Move Tutors.

cards.title: Melhorias em relação a Diamond e Pearl
cards.content:
• Jogo mais rápido, sobretudo no Surf e nas batalhas.
  • Níveis dos adversários ajustados e ginásios só com o tipo do líder.
  • Bicicleta liberada nos portões entre rotas.
  • Defog e Strength em lugares mais lógicos, e treinadores nos Pokémon Centers.
  • A Amity Square aceita os iniciais de Sinnoh.

en.title: Improvements over Diamond and Pearl
en.content:
• A faster game, especially when surfing and in battle.
  • Rebalanced opponent levels and Gyms using only the leader’s type.
  • Bicycles allowed in the gatehouses between routes.
  • Defog and Strength in more sensible places, and Trainers at Pokémon Centers.
  • Amity Square accepts the Sinnoh starters.

cards.title: Novidades desta versão
cards.content:
• Os 493 Pokémon podem andar atrás de você.
  • O Pokéwalker, pedômetro que vinha com o jogo.
  • O Pokéathlon, com dez provas.
  • As Kimono Girls e o encontro obrigatório com o lendário da capa.

en.title: What this version introduced
en.content:
• All 493 Pokémon can walk behind you.
  • The Pokéwalker, a pedometer bundled with the game.
  • The Pokéathlon, with ten events.
  • The Kimono Girls and the mandatory encounter with the cover legendary.
  • Legendaries from other regions and the Arceus event at the Sinjoh Ruins.
  • The Johto Safari Zone and the Battle Frontier.

cards.title: Melhorias em relação a Gold, Silver e Crystal
cards.content:
• Mecânicas da Geração 4, com a divisão física/especial.
  • Menus, mochila e PC na tela de toque.
  • Kurt, as Apricorns e a Apricorn Box voltam; berries passam a vir dos Jugglers e das Berry Pots.
  • Headbutt em árvores também dá Pokémon de Hoenn e Sinnoh depois da Pokédex Nacional.
  • Conteúdo de Crystal incorporado, como o Eusine.

en.title: Improvements over Gold, Silver and Crystal
en.content:
• Generation 4 mechanics, with the physical/special split.
  • Menus, Bag and PC on the touch screen.
  • Kurt, Apricorns and the Apricorn Box return; Berries now come from Jugglers and Berry Pots.
  • Headbutting trees also yields Hoenn and Sinnoh Pokémon after the National Pokédex.
  • Crystal content folded in, such as Eusine.

cards.title: Como usar este roteiro
cards.content:
HeartGold e SoulSilver refazem Gold e Silver: oito insígnias em Johto, a Liga em Indigo Plateau e, depois, mais oito insígnias em Kanto, até o Red no topo do Mt. Silver. O lendário da capa muda com o cartucho: Ho-Oh em HeartGold, Lugia em SoulSilver. Seu primeiro Pokémon anda atrás de você pelo caminho todo.

Use o Mapa Múndi para conferir Pokémon, níveis e taxas de encontro em cada área, e a aba Treinadores para os times completos.

en.title: How to use this walkthrough
en.content:
HeartGold and SoulSilver remake Gold and Silver: eight badges in Johto, the League at Indigo Plateau and then eight more badges in Kanto, all the way to Red at the top of Mt. Silver. The cover legendary depends on the cartridge: Ho-Oh in HeartGold, Lugia in SoulSilver. Your lead Pokémon follows you the whole way.

Use the Region Map to check Pokémon, levels and encounter rates in each area, and the Trainers tab for the full teams.

cards.title: 1. New Bark, o Professor Elm e o Mr. Pokémon
cards.content:
New Bark Town → Rota 29 → Cherrygrove City → Rota 30 → Rota 31

  • O Professor Elm te deixa escolher Chikorita, Cyndaquil ou Totodile.
  • Leve a encomenda até a casa do Mr. Pokémon. Lá você recebe um Ovo misterioso, e o Professor Oak entrega a Pokédex.
  • Na volta, em Cherrygrove, o Silver te desafia com o inicial que roubou do laboratório (Nv. 5).

en.title: 1. New Bark, Professor Elm and Mr. Pokémon
en.content:
New Bark Town → Route 29 → Cherrygrove City → Route 30 → Route 31

  • Professor Elm lets you pick Chikorita, Cyndaquil or Totodile.
  • Take the errand to Mr. Pokémon’s house. There you receive a mysterious Egg, and Professor Oak hands you the Pokédex.
  • On the way back, in Cherrygrove, Silver challenges you with the starter he stole from the lab (Lv. 5).

cards.title: 2. Violet City, a Sprout Tower e Falkner
cards.content:
Rota 31 → Violet City → Sprout Tower

  • No topo da Sprout Tower, vença o Sage Li e ganhe a HM05 Flash.
  • Vença o Falkner (ás: Pidgeotto, Nv. 13). Pokémon de Pedra ou Elétrico resolvem.
  • O assistente do Elm te espera no Pokémon Center com o Ovo, de onde nasce um Togepi.

en.title: 2. Violet City, the Sprout Tower and Falkner
en.content:
Route 31 → Violet City → Sprout Tower

  • At the top of the Sprout Tower, beat Sage Li and get HM05 Flash.
  • Beat Falkner (ace: Pidgeotto, Lv. 13). Rock or Electric Pokémon do the job.
  • Elm’s aide waits at the Pokémon Center with the Egg, which hatches into Togepi.

cards.content:
Rota 32 → Union Cave → Rota 33 → Azalea Town → Slowpoke Well

  • A Team Rocket corta a cauda dos Slowpoke dentro do poço de Azalea.
  • No fundo do Slowpoke Well, vença o Proton (Nv. 12).
  • Vença o Bugsy (ás: Scyther, Nv. 17). Ao sair, o Silver te enfrenta (Nv. 18).

en.title: 3. Union Cave, Slowpoke Well and Bugsy
en.content:
Route 32 → Union Cave → Route 33 → Azalea Town → Slowpoke Well

  • Team Rocket is cutting off Slowpoke tails inside Azalea’s well.
  • At the bottom of the Slowpoke Well, beat Proton (Lv. 12).
  • Beat Bugsy (ace: Scyther, Lv. 17). On your way out, Silver challenges you (Lv. 18).

cards.title: 4. Ilex Forest, Goldenrod e Whitney
cards.content:
Ilex Forest → Rota 34 → Goldenrod City

  • No Ilex Forest, ajude o aprendiz do Kurt a recuperar o Farfetch’d e ganhe a HM01 Cut.
  • Em Goldenrod, ganhe a Bicycle na loja de bicicletas.
  • Vença a Whitney (ás: Miltank, Nv. 19). O Rollout e o Attract do Miltank são o maior obstáculo do começo do jogo.
  • Com a insígnia, a floricultura te dá o SquirtBottle.

en.title: 4. Ilex Forest, Goldenrod and Whitney
en.content:
Ilex Forest → Route 34 → Goldenrod City

  • In Ilex Forest, help Kurt’s apprentice catch the Farfetch’d and get HM01 Cut.
  • In Goldenrod, get the Bicycle at the bike shop.
  • Beat Whitney (ace: Miltank, Lv. 19). Miltank’s Rollout and Attract are the biggest hurdle of the early game.
  • With the badge, the flower shop gives you the SquirtBottle.

cards.title: 5. Ecruteak, a Burned Tower e Morty
cards.content:
Rota 35 → National Park → Rota 36 → Rota 37 → Ecruteak City

  • Use o SquirtBottle na árvore que bloqueia a Rota 36: é um Sudowoodo.
  • Na Burned Tower, o Silver te enfrenta (Nv. 22). No subsolo, Raikou, Entei e Suicune despertam e fogem.
  • Vença o Morty (ás: Gengar, Nv. 25). Golpes Normais e Lutadores não pegam em Fantasma.
  • No Dance Theater, expulse um Grunt da Team Rocket mal-educado; em agradecimento, um senhor te dá a HM03 Surf.

en.title: 5. Ecruteak, the Burned Tower and Morty
en.content:
Route 35 → National Park → Route 36 → Route 37 → Ecruteak City

  • Use the SquirtBottle on the tree blocking Route 36: it is a Sudowoodo.
  • In the Burned Tower, Silver challenges you (Lv. 22). In the basement, Raikou, Entei and Suicune awaken and flee.
  • Beat Morty (ace: Gengar, Lv. 25). Normal and Fighting moves do not touch Ghosts.
  • At the Dance Theater, drive off a rude Team Rocket Grunt; to thank you, a gentleman gives you HM03 Surf.

  • Atravesse o mar até Cianwood e vença o Chuck (ás: Poliwrath, Nv. 31).
  • A esposa do Chuck te dá a HM02 Fly, e a farmácia entrega o SecretPotion.

en.title: 6. Olivine, the lighthouse and Cianwood
en.content:
Route 38 → Route 39 → Olivine City → Route 40 → Route 41 → Cianwood City

  • Jasmine will not leave the lighthouse: the Ampharos that lights the harbour is sick.
  • Cross the sea to Cianwood and beat Chuck (ace: Poliwrath, Lv. 31).
  • Chuck’s wife gives you HM02 Fly, and the pharmacy hands over the SecretPotion.

cards.title: 7. Jasmine, Lake of Rage e o esconderijo Rocket
cards.content:
Olivine City → Rota 42 → Mahogany Town → Rota 43 → Lake of Rage

  • Leve o remédio ao Ampharos e vença a Jasmine (ás: Steelix, Nv. 35).
  • Na Rota 42, um Hiker que sai correndo do Mt. Mortar te dá a HM04 Strength.
  • No Lake of Rage, enfrente o Gyarados vermelho e fique com a Red Scale.
  • O Lance te chama para invadir o esconderijo da Team Rocket sob a loja de Mahogany: vença o Petrel (Nv. 24) e a Ariana (Nv. 27).
  • No fim, o Lance te dá a HM06 Whirlpool.

en.title: 7. Jasmine, Lake of Rage and the Rocket hideout
en.content:
Olivine City → Route 42 → Mahogany Town → Route 43 → Lake of Rage

  • Bring the medicine to Ampharos and beat Jasmine (ace: Steelix, Lv. 35).
  • On Route 42, a Hiker running out of Mt. Mortar gives you HM04 Strength.
  • At the Lake of Rage, face the red Gyarados and keep the Red Scale.
  • Lance asks you to raid Team Rocket’s hideout under the Mahogany shop: beat Petrel (Lv. 24) and Ariana (Lv. 27).
  • At the end, Lance gives you HM06 Whirlpool.

  • Na torre, vença o Proton (Nv. 33), o Petrel (Nv. 32), a Ariana (Nv. 32) e, no topo, o Archer (Nv. 38).

en.title: 8. Pryce and the Radio Tower
en.content:
Mahogany Town → Goldenrod City → Goldenrod Tunnel → Radio Tower

  • Beat Pryce (ace: Piloswine, Lv. 34). Fire, Fighting and Steel work well against Piloswine.

  • In the tower, beat Proton (Lv. 33), Petrel (Lv. 32), Ariana (Lv. 32) and, at the top, Archer (Lv. 38).

  • Beat Clair (ace: Kingdra, Lv. 41). Kingdra only takes extra damage from Dragon moves.

cards.title: 10. O lendário do seu cartucho
cards.content:
Ecruteak City → Bell Tower (HeartGold) · Whirl Islands (SoulSilver)

  • Com as oito insígnias, o Professor Elm te dá a Master Ball.
  • No Dance Theater de Ecruteak, vença as cinco Kimono Girls em sequência e receba a Clear Bell (HeartGold) ou a Tidal Bell (SoulSilver).
  • Elas dançam para chamar o lendário: o Ho-Oh no alto da Bell Tower, em HeartGold; o Lugia no fundo das Whirl Islands, em SoulSilver.
  • Salve antes de enfrentar.

en.title: 10. Your cartridge’s legendary
en.content:
Ecruteak City → Bell Tower (HeartGold) · Whirl Islands (SoulSilver)

  • With all eight badges, Professor Elm gives you the Master Ball.
  • At the Ecruteak Dance Theater, beat the five Kimono Girls in a row and receive the Clear Bell (HeartGold) or the Tidal Bell (SoulSilver).
  • They dance to summon the legendary: Ho-Oh at the top of the Bell Tower in HeartGold; Lugia deep in the Whirl Islands in SoulSilver.
  • Save before the fight.

  • Vença o Lt. Surge (ás: Electabuzz, Nv. 53).

en.title: 12. On to Kanto
en.content:
Olivine City → S.S. Aqua → Vermilion City

  • Elm gives you the S.S. Aqua ticket, which sails from Olivine to Vermilion.
  • Beat Lt. Surge (ace: Electabuzz, Lv. 53).
  • The Power Plant is down: find the stolen part and the Magnet Train links Goldenrod and Saffron again.

cards.title: 13. As insígnias de Kanto
cards.content:
Saffron · Cerulean · Celadon · Fuchsia · Pewter · Cinnabar

  • Kanto não tem ordem fixa: os líderes estão entre o Nv. 50 e o 59.
  • Sabrina (ás: Alakazam, Nv. 55), Misty (ás: Starmie, Nv. 54), Erika (ás: Victreebel, Nv. 56) e Janine (ás: Venomoth, Nv. 50).
  • Brock (ás: Onix, Nv. 54) e Blaine, que perdeu o ginásio e luta nas Seafoam Islands (ás: Rapidash, Nv. 59).
  • Em Lavender Town ficam a Radio Tower de Kanto e a House of Memories (a Soul House de Gold/Silver), o memorial que guarda os túmulos da antiga Pokémon Tower.
  • Com a Power Plant consertada, a Radio Tower de Lavender instala a Expansion Card no Pokégear. O canal da Poké Flute acorda o Snorlax diante do Diglett’s Cave.

en.title: 13. The Kanto badges
en.content:
Saffron · Cerulean · Celadon · Fuchsia · Pewter · Cinnabar

  • Kanto has no fixed order: the leaders range from Lv. 50 to 59.
  • Sabrina (ace: Alakazam, Lv. 55), Misty (ace: Starmie, Lv. 54), Erika (ace: Victreebel, Lv. 56) and Janine (ace: Venomoth, Lv. 50).
  • Brock (ace: Onix, Lv. 54) and Blaine, who lost his Gym and battles on the Seafoam Islands (ace: Rapidash, Lv. 59).
  • Lavender Town holds the Kanto Radio Tower and the House of Memories (Gold/Silver’s Soul House), the memorial that holds the graves from the old Pokémon Tower.
  • With the Power Plant fixed, the Lavender Radio Tower installs the Expansion Card on your Pokégear. The Poké Flute channel wakes the Snorlax in front of Diglett’s Cave.

cards.content:

  • No Mt. Moon, o Silver te espera (Nv. 50).
  • O ginásio de Viridian fica fechado até você encontrar o Blue nas Cinnabar Islands; só então ele volta para lutar.
  • Vença o Blue (ás: Pidgeot, Nv. 60) e complete as 16 insígnias.

en.title: 14. Mt. Moon and Blue
en.content:
Route 3 → Mt. Moon → Viridian City

Diamond e Pearl são a campanha original de Sinnoh. en.title: 5. The Galactic building and the Bicycle
en.content:
Team Galactic Eterna Building → Route 206 → Route 207 → Mt. Coronet

  • Storm the Team Galactic building and beat Jupiter (ace: Skuntank, Lv. 23).
  • The bike shop owner is freed and gives you the Bicycle.
  • Ride down the Cycling Road, Route 206. At the gatehouse, Lucas/Dawn’s father gives you the Exp. Share once you have seen 35 Pokémon.

cards.title: 6. Hearthome e Fantina
cards.content:
Mt. Coronet → Rota 208 → Hearthome City

  • O presidente do Pokémon Fan Club entrega o Poffin Case.
  • Vença a Fantina (ás: Mismagius, Nv. 26). Em Platinum ela já é a terceira líder.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Super Concursos no Contest Hall, e a Amity Square

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Super Contests at the Contest Hall, and Amity Square

en.title: 6. Hearthome and Fantina
en.content:
Mt. Coronet → Route 208 → Hearthome City

  • The Pokémon Fan Club Chairman gives you the Poffin Case.
  • Beat Fantina (ace: Mismagius, Lv. 26). In Platinum she is already the third leader.

cards.title: 7. Solaceon, as ruínas e a Lost Tower
cards.content:
Rota 209 → Solaceon Town → Solaceon Ruins → Rota 210 (sul)

  • O Barry te enfrenta na Rota 209 (Nv. 27).
  • Nas Solaceon Ruins, siga as salas dos Unown até a HM05 Defog.
  • A Rota 210 para o norte está bloqueada por um bando de Psyduck — por enquanto.

fields.label: Necessário
fields.value: Seguir pela Rota 210 sul até a 215

en.label: Required
en.value: Continue down Route 210 south to Route 215

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Day Care de Solaceon, e a Lost Tower, que pede Defog nos andares de cima

en.label: Worth it
en.value: The Solaceon Day Care, and the Lost Tower, whose upper floors need Defog

en.title: 7. Solaceon, the ruins and the Lost Tower
en.content:
Route 209 → Solaceon Town → Solaceon Ruins → Route 210 (south)

  • Barry challenges you on Route 209 (Lv. 27).
  • In the Solaceon Ruins, follow the Unown rooms to HM05 Defog.
  • Route 210 north is blocked by a group of Psyduck — for now.

cards.title: 8. Veilstone, Maylene e a HM Fly
cards.content:
Rota 210 (sul) → Rota 215 → Veilstone City

  • Vença a Maylene (ás: Lucario, Nv. 32).
  • Com o Looker, no depósito da Team Galactic, apanhe a HM02 Fly.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: A loja de departamentos de Veilstone, com TMs e itens de treino

en.label: Worth it
en.value: The Veilstone Department Store, with TMs and training items

en.title: 8. Veilstone, Maylene and HM Fly
en.content:
Route 210 (south) → Route 215 → Veilstone City

  • Beat Maylene (ace: Lucario, Lv. 32).
  • With Looker, in the Team Galactic warehouse, pick up HM02 Fly.

cards.title: 9. Pastoria e Crasher Wake
cards.content:
Rota 214 → Valor Lakefront → Rota 213 → Pastoria City

  • O Barry te enfrenta antes do ginásio (Nv. 36).
  • Vença o Crasher Wake (ás: Floatzel, Nv. 37).
  • A Cynthia entrega o SecretPotion, para os Psyduck da Rota 210.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: O Great Marsh, o safári de Pastoria, e a Pokémon Mansion na Rota 212

en.label: Worth it
en.value: The Great Marsh, Pastoria’s Safari, and the Pokémon Mansion on Route 212

en.title: 9. Pastoria and Crasher Wake
en.content:
Route 214 → Valor Lakefront → Route 213 → Pastoria City

  • Barry challenges you before the Gym (Lv. 36).
  • Beat Crasher Wake (ace: Floatzel, Lv. 37).
  • Cynthia gives you the SecretPotion, for the Psyduck on Route 210.

cards.title: 10. Celestic Town e o primeiro Cyrus
cards.content:
Rota 210 (norte) → Celestic Town

  • Use o SecretPotion nos Psyduck e siga pela neblina da Rota 210 norte. A Cynthia te pede para levar o Old Charm à avó dela.
  • Nas ruínas de Celestic, vença o Cyrus (Nv. 36).
  • A avó da Cynthia entrega a HM03 Surf.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Com Surf, a Fuego Ironworks, perto de Floaroma

en.label: Worth it
en.value: With Surf, the Fuego Ironworks, near Floaroma

en.title: 10. Celestic Town and the first Cyrus
en.content:
Route 210 (north) → Celestic Town

  • Use the SecretPotion on the Psyduck and head through the fog of Route 210 north. Cynthia asks you to take the Old Charm to her grandmother.
  • At the Celestic ruins, beat Cyrus (Lv. 36).
  • Cynthia’s grandmother gives you HM03 Surf.

cards.title: 11. Canalave, Iron Island e Byron
cards.content:
Rota 218 → Canalave City → Iron Island

  • O Barry te espera em Canalave (Nv. 38).
  • O Byron só te recebe depois da Iron Island: lá o Riley entrega a HM04 Strength e atravessa a mina com você.
  • Vença o Byron (ás: Bastiodon, Nv. 41).

fields.label: Necessário
fields.value: HM04 Strength com o Riley, e vencer o Byron

en.label: Required
en.value: HM04 Strength from Riley, then beat Byron

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Novidade de Platinum: a câmara do Registeel na Iron Island, que só abre com um Regigigas no time

en.label: Worth it
en.value: New in Platinum: the Registeel chamber on Iron Island, which only opens with a Regigigas in your party

en.title: 11. Canalave, Iron Island and Byron
en.content:
Route 218 → Canalave City → Iron Island

  • Barry waits in Canalave (Lv. 38).
  • Byron only sees you after Iron Island: there Riley gives you HM04 Strength and crosses the mine with you.
  • Beat Byron (ace: Bastiodon, Lv. 41).

cards.title: 12. Os lagos, a Rota 217 e Candice
cards.content:
Lake Valor → Lake Verity → Mt. Coronet → Rota 216 → Rota 217 → Snowpoint City

  • A Team Galactic ataca os lagos: vença o Saturn no Lake Valor (Nv. 40) e a Mars no Lake Verity (Nv. 40).
  • Atravesse o Mt. Coronet para as rotas de neve. Na primeira casa da Rota 217, pegue a HM08 Rock Climb.
  • Vença a Candice em Snowpoint (ás: Froslass, Nv. 44).

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: A HM08 Rock Climb só funciona fora de batalha depois desta insígnia

en.label: Worth it
en.value: HM08 Rock Climb only works outside battle after this Badge

en.title: 12. The lakes, Route 217 and Candice
en.content:
Lake Valor → Lake Verity → Mt. Coronet → Route 216 → Route 217 → Snowpoint City

  • Team Galactic strikes the lakes: beat Saturn at Lake Valor (Lv. 40) and Mars at Lake Verity (Lv. 40).
  • Cross Mt. Coronet to the snowy routes. In the first house on Route 217, pick up HM08 Rock Climb.
  • Beat Candice in Snowpoint (ace: Froslass, Lv. 44).

cards.title: 13. O QG da Team Galactic
cards.content:
Snowpoint City → Veilstone City → Team Galactic HQ

  • No depósito da Galactic, pegue a Galactic Key: ela abre as portas de aço do QG.
  • Vença o Saturn (Nv. 44) e o Cyrus (Nv. 46) no QG.
  • Liberte Uxie, Mesprit e Azelf.

fields.label: Necessário
fields.value: Vencer o Saturn e o Cyrus no QG

en.label: Required
en.value: Beat Saturn and Cyrus at the HQ

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Repare no Charon, cientista da Galactic que só existe em Platinum

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Note Charon, the Galactic scientist who only exists in Platinum

en.title: 13. The Team Galactic HQ
en.content:
Snowpoint City → Veilstone City → Team Galactic HQ

  • In the Galactic warehouse, grab the Galactic Key: it opens the HQ’s steel doors.
  • Beat Saturn (Lv. 44) and Cyrus (Lv. 46) at the HQ.
  • Free Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf.

cards.title: 14. Spear Pillar e o Distortion World
cards.content:
Mt. Coronet → Spear Pillar → Distortion World

  • No Spear Pillar, ao lado do Barry, enfrente a Mars e a Jupiter numa batalha em dupla (Nv. 46).
  • O Giratina surge e arrasta o Cyrus para o Distortion World. Com a Cynthia, siga atrás.
  • Vença o Cyrus pela última vez (Nv. 48) e encontre o Giratina na Forma Origem.

fields.label: Necessário
fields.value: Vencer o Cyrus no Distortion World

en.label: Required
en.value: Beat Cyrus in the Distortion World

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Salve antes do Giratina: a taxa de captura dele é 3, a mais baixa do jogo

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Save before Giratina: its catch rate is 3, the lowest in the game

en.title: 14. Spear Pillar and the Distortion World
en.content:
Mt. Coronet → Spear Pillar → Distortion World

  • At the Spear Pillar, alongside Barry, face Mars and Jupiter in a Double Battle (Lv. 46).
  • Giratina emerges and drags Cyrus into the Distortion World. Follow with Cynthia.
  • Beat Cyrus one last time (Lv. 48) and meet Giratina in its Origin Forme.

cards.title: 15. Sunyshore e Volkner
cards.content:
Sendoff Spring → Rota 222 → Sunyshore City

  • Depois do Distortion World, os guardiões dos lagos podem ser capturados.
  • Vença o Volkner (ás: Electivire, Nv. 50).
  • A Jasmine, de passagem por Sunyshore, entrega a HM07 Waterfall.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Capturar Uxie, Azelf e Mesprit antes da Liga

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Catch Uxie, Azelf and Mesprit before the League

en.title: 15. Sunyshore and Volkner
en.content:
Sendoff Spring → Route 222 → Sunyshore City

  • After the Distortion World, the lake guardians can be caught.
  • Beat Volkner (ace: Electivire, Lv. 50).
  • Jasmine, visiting Sunyshore, gives you HM07 Waterfall.

cards.title: 16. Victory Road, Elite Four e Cynthia
cards.content:
Rota 223 → Pokémon League (sul) → Victory Road → Pokémon League

  • O Barry te enfrenta na entrada da Liga (Nv. 51).
  • Elite Four: Aaron (Nv. 53), Bertha (Nv. 55), Flint (Nv. 57), Lucian (Nv. 59).
  • Campeã: Cynthia (ás: Garchomp, Nv. 62).

fields.label: Necessário
fields.value: Vencer os quatro e a Cynthia

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: O Garchomp é Dragão e Terrestre: golpe de Gelo causa dano quádruplo

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Garchomp is Dragon and Ground: an Ice move deals quadruple damage

en.title: 16. Victory Road, the Elite Four and Cynthia
en.content:
Route 223 → Pokémon League (south) → Victory Road → Pokémon League

  • Barry challenges you at the League entrance (Lv. 51).
  • Elite Four: Aaron (Lv. 53), Bertha (Lv. 55), Flint (Lv. 57), Lucian (Lv. 59).
  • Champion: Cynthia (ace: Garchomp, Lv. 62).

cards.title: 17. Pós-jogo de Platinum
cards.content:
Sandgem Town → Snowpoint City → Battle Zone → Stark Mountain

  • O Rowan entrega a Pokédex Nacional e o Poké Radar.
  • De Snowpoint, o barco leva à Battle Zone: Fight Area, Battle Frontier e Survival Area.
  • Na Stark Mountain, com o Buck, a Team Galactic volta (Nv. 60) — e no fundo da montanha espera o Heatran.
  • Pela Turnback Cave, volte ao Distortion World para buscar a Griseous Orb.

fields.label: Vale a pena
fields.value: Cresselia na Fullmoon Island, Regigigas no Snowpoint Temple (com os três Regis) e a revanche da Elite Four, com níveis mais altos

en.label: Worth it
en.value: Cresselia on Fullmoon Island, Regigigas at the Snowpoint Temple (with the three Regis) and the Elite Four rematch, at higher levels

en.title: 17. Platinum post-game
en.content:
Sandgem Town → Snowpoint City → Battle Zone → Stark Mountain

  • Rowan gives you the National Pokédex and the Poké Radar.
  • From Snowpoint, the ferry takes you to the Battle Zone: the Fight Area, the Battle Frontier and the Survival Area.
  • At Stark Mountain, with Buck, Team Galactic returns (Lv. 60) — and Heatran waits deep inside the mountain.
  • Through Turnback Cave, return to the Distortion World for the Griseous Orb.
